user.title: Casa Energy — New instance
user.description: Give this configuration a name (useful if in the future you want to track multiple meters, e.g. Home and Office).

energy_sensors.title: Energy consumption sensors
energy_sensors.description: Select one or more sensors with device_class 'energy' whose monthly history you want to track.

tariff.title: Electricity tariff
tariff.description: Enter your tariff details to calculate an estimated monthly cost. Always double-check these values against your real bill.

power.title: Instant power
power.description: Configure your meter/system's maximum power and alert thresholds. Total instant power will be calculated by summing the loads you'll add in the next step.

add_load.title: Loads to monitor ({count} added)
add_load.description: Add at least one load (name + power sensor in Watts): total power will be calculated by summing all loads added here. Leave empty and continue when done.

data.name: Load name
data.add_another: Add another load after this one

add_display_load.title: Devices to display separately ({count} added)
add_display_load.description: Optional. Add devices here that you want shown as a separate item in the card, but that should NOT be summed into the total (e.g. if they're already included in one of the previous loads). Leave empty and continue to finish setup.

data.name: Device name
data.add_another: Add another device after this one

error.no_energy_sensors: Select at least one energy sensor.
error.no_loads: Add at least one load: total power is calculated by summing them.
error.duplicate_entity: This sensor has already been added to this list.

power.title: Instant power
power.description: Total instant power is calculated by summing the loads configured in the next step.

manage_loads.title: Manage loads
manage_loads.description: Select any loads to remove, or check 'Add more' to add new ones. At least one load must always remain.

add_load_option.title: Add load ({count} already added)
add_load_option.description: Add a load (name + power sensor). Leave empty and continue to finish.

data.name: Load name
data.add_another: Add another load after this one

manage_display_loads.title: Manage display-only devices
manage_display_loads.description: These devices are shown as a separate item in the card, but are NOT summed into the total. Select any to remove, or check 'Add more' to add new ones.

add_display_load_option.title: Add device ({count} already added)
add_display_load_option.description: Add a device to display (name + power sensor). Not included in the total. Leave empty and continue to finish.

data.name: Device name
data.add_another: Add another device after this one

error.no_energy_sensors: Select at least one energy sensor.
error.no_loads: At least one load must remain: total power is calculated by summing them.
error.duplicate_entity: This sensor has already been added to this list.
